sents.zh: 上个月，爸爸带我去坐船。
sents.en: Last month my father took me out on a boat.

sents.zh: 我们早上六点就起床了。
sents.en: We got up at six in the morning.

sents.zh: 因为要坐很久的车，所以出去得很早。
sents.en: Because it was a long ride, we set out early.

sents.zh: 到了河边，我看见很多船。
sents.en: At the river I saw many boats.

sents.zh: 我们的船不大，可是很干净。
sents.en: Ours was not large, but it was very clean.

sents.zh: 船开的时候，我有一点不放心。
sents.en: When it started moving I felt a little uneasy.
But after a while I felt fine.

sents.zh: 船在水上走得很慢，很舒服。
sents.en: The boat moved slowly on the water; it was comfortable.
A breeze came across and it was not hot at all.
I saw many fish in the water.

sents.zh: 天上还有几只鸟一直跟着我们。
sents.en: A few birds in the sky followed us the whole way.

sents.zh: 中午，妈妈拿出了她做的饭。
sents.en: At noon Mother took out the food she had made.

sents.zh: 我们一边吃，一边看两边的山。
sents.en: We ate and looked at the hills on either side.

sents.zh: 下午三点，船回到了河边。
sents.en: At three in the afternoon the boat returned to the bank.

sents.zh: 这一天过得很快，我一直记到现在。
sents.en: The day went by fast, and I remember it still.
